==={{header|FreeBASIC}}===
Uses the code from the [[Totient_function#FreeBASIC|Totient Function]] example as an include.

<syntaxhighlight lang="freebasic">#include"totient.bas"

dim as uinteger found = 0, curr = 3, sum, toti

while found < 20
    sum = totient(curr)
    toti = sum
    do
        toti = totient(toti)
        sum += toti
    loop while toti <> 1  
    if sum = curr then
        print sum
        found += 1
    end if
    curr += 1
wend</syntaxhighlight>
